bio.text: David Sieck, a Republican, represents District 16 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Sieck as serving a sixth term.
The biography describes Sieck as a farmer and licensed real estate salesperson, and a past president of the Iowa Corn Growers Association.
It says Sieck attended Glenwood High School, Iowa Western Community College and Iowa State University, was born in 1957 in Council Bluffs and lives in Glenwood.
